book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises Katungoale Ohl Limekid
Mwurin mepwukat, Sises ketin kotehla Lehen Kalili (de Lehen Daipirias.)
Eri, pokon kalaimwun ehu ahpw idawehnla, pwehki ar kilangehr kilel akan me e ketin wiahiong me soumwahu ko.
Sises ahpw ketidahla pohn dohl ehu oh ketidiong wasao, iangahki sapwellime tohnpadahk ko.
Eri, Sarawien Pahsohpa en mehn Suhs ako kerendohr.
Sises eri mahsenla ahpw mahsanihda pokon kalaimwun ehu me kohkodohng reh, e ahpw mahsanihong Pilip, “Ia wasa kitail kak pwain sang ie kisin mwenge me pahn itarohng kamwengehda aramas pwukat koaros?”
(E ketin mahsanih mepwukat pwe en ketin song Pilip, pwe pein ih mwahngih dahme e pahn ketin wia.)
Pilip ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ong soangen tohto wet, ma emenemen pahn tungoale ekiste, kitail pahn anahne mwohni silper
riepwiki.”
Emen sapwellime tohnpadahk, Andru, rien Saimon Piter, ahpw patohwanohng Sises,
“Kisin pwutak kis mie met, me eh tungoal lopwon en pilawa limau me wiawihda sang wahn parli oh mwahmw riemen. A da katepen kisin mwenge tikitik pwukat ong kiden aramas wet?”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kamwohdangiraildi.” (Eri, wasao me rehn mehlel.) Eri, aramas koaros ahpw mwohndi, wadarail mpen ohl limekid.
Sises eri ketin ale lopwon en pilawa ko, ahpw ketin wia loulou en kaping, oh ketin nehkohng irail me mwohndier ko, pil duwehte mwahmw ko, duwen me itarohng arail anahn akan.
Ni ar medla, e ahpw ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Kumwail doukada luhwarail kan, pwe ekis dehr lekdekla mwahl.”
Irail eri rikpene luhwe ko koaros sang ni lopwon en pilawa limauo, oh re audekihda kopwou eisek riau luhwarail ko.
Ni aramas ako me mi wasao ar kilangehr kilel wet me Sises ketin wiadahr, re ahpw nda, “Mehlel, ohl menet iei ih Soukohpo
me pahn pwarodohng sampah!”
Ni Sises eh ketin mwangihada me irail pahn kodohng ale, pwe re en kasapwiladahng nanmwarki, e ahpw kelehpw ketila sang rehrail oh ketidalahng pohn nahnao.
Sises ketin Alu pohn Leho
Ni eh soutikpenehr, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko kohdilahng nan leho.
Irail ahpw dakehda pwoht ehu, oh kotehla leho pwuralahng Kapernaum. Eri, wasa pahn pwongier, a Sises saikinte lellahng rehrail.
Me inenen engimah mehlel, oh nan leho me angin.
Ni tohnpadahk ko ar seiseikiher ele mwail siluh de pahieu, re ahpw kilangada Sises eh ketiket kohdo pohn leho, ni eh kereniong wararail pwohto, re ahpw masepwehkada.
E ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail dehr masepwehk, ngehi met!”
Irail eri perenda kasamwo ong pohn pwohto, oh ni ahnsowohte pwohto lel ni oaroahro, wasa me irail kohkolahng ie.
Aramas ako Rapahki Sises

Mandahn rahno, aramas ako me mihmihte palio leho ahpw kilangada me pwoht tehpwoat mihmi wasao. Re ese me Sises sohte ketin iang sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ketidahng pohn pwohto, pwe sapwellime tohnpadahk kohte me mweselda.
Pwoht kei sang Daipirias pil tangalahng ni oaroahr ehu me kereniong wasa me pokono tungoaleier pilawa ko me Kaun-o ketin loulou kapingkalahnganki.
Eri, ni ahnsou me pokono kilangehr me Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko sohte ket wasao, irail ahpw dakehda pwoht kei oh kolahng Kapernaum, pwe re en rapahki Sises wasao.
Sises, iei Pilawahn Komour
Ni ar diarada Sises palio leho, re ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing Sounpadahk, iahd me komw ketido wasaht?”
Sises eri ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: kumwail raparapahkin ie pwehki amwail kangehr lopwon en pilawa ko oh medkihla, kaidehn pwehki amwail kilangehr kilel akan.

Kumwail dehr doadoahk ong mwenge me kin kiteila, a kumwail doadoahk ong mwenge me kin mihmihte ong mour soutuk, me Nein-Aramas pahn kihong kumwail; pwe Koht Sahm ketin kadehdedahr duwen eh kin kupwurperenki ih.”
Irail eri patohwan kalelapak reh, “A dahme se kak wia pwe se en kapwaiada sapwellimen Koht doadoahk?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Iet doadoahk me Koht ketin kupwurki kumwail en wia: kumwail en pwoson ih me e ketin kadarodo.
Re ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Kilel da me komw pahn wia, pwe se en kak kilang oh pwosonkin komwi? Dahme komw pahn ketin wia?
Samatail kahlap ako tungoaleier manna nan sapwtehno, nin duwen Pwuhk Sarawi eh mahsanih, ‘E ketikihong irail pilawa sang nanleng pwe re en tungoale.’”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: pilawa me Moses kihongkumwailo kaidehn pilawa sang nanleng, pwe Semei, iei ih me ketikihong kumwail pilawa mehlel sang nanleng.
Pilawa me Koht kin ketikihda, iei ih me ketidihdo sang nanleng oh ketikihong sampah mour.”
Irail ahpw patohwan peki reh, “Maing, komw ketikihong kiht pilawa wet ahnsou koaros.”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ngehi me pilawahn komour. Mehmen me kin kohdo rehi solahr pahn men mwengehda, oh mehmen me kin pwoson ie solahr pahn men nimpilda.
A I ndaiongkumwailehr me kumwail kilangieier, a kumwail ahpw sohte men pwoson.
Aramas koaros me Semei kin ketikihong ie pahn kohdo rehi, a I sohte pahn kapwurehla emen me kohdo rehi.
Pwe I kohdihdo sang nanleng pwe I en kapwaiada kupwur en ih me ketin kadariehdo, a kaidehn pwe I en wia nsenei.
A iet kupwur en ih me ketin kadariehdo: I en dehr kasalongehla emen sang rehn koaros me e ketikihongieier, a I en komourirailla ni imwilahn rahn.
Pwe iet duwen kupwur en Semei: irail koaros me kilang Sapwellimeo oh pwoson, re en ahneki mour soutuk, oh I pahn komourirailda ni imwilahn rahn.”
Mehn Suhs ako eri tapihada lipahnede pwehki eh mahsanih, “Ngehi me pilawa me kohdihdo sang nanleng.”
Irail eri nda, “Kaidehn ih Sises met, nein Sosepo? Se ese seme oh ine. Eri, ia duwen eh kak nda ahnsou wet me e kohdihdo sang nanleng?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail dehr lipahned nanpwungamwail.
Sohte emen me pahn kak kohdo rehi, ma Semei me ketin kadariehdo sohte kainangihedo rehi; oh I pahn komourada ni imwilahn rahn.
Soukohp ako ntingihedier, ‘Irail koaros pahn ale padahk sang rehn Koht.’ Emenemen me rong Sahmo oh padahngkihsang, e kin kohdo rehi.
Met sohte wehwehki me emen kilangehr Sahmo; ahpw ihte me kohdo sang rehn Koht, iei ihete me kilangehr Sahmo.
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: mehmen me pwoson, iei ih me kin ahneki mour soutuk.
Ngehi me pilawahn komour.
Samamwail ko kangalahr manna nan sapwtehno, ahpw re melahr.
A iet duwen pilawa me kohdihdo sang nanleng, mehmen me pahn tungoale, e sohte pahn mehla.
Ngehi me pilawahn komour me kohdihdo sang nanleng. Ma mehmen pahn tungoale pilawa wet, e pahn momour kohkohlahte. Eri, pilawa me I pahn kihda, iei udukei, me I kihda pwe sampah en mourkihla.”
Met kahrehda en mehn Suhs ko ar tapihada akamaipene nanpwungarail. Irail eri idek, “Ia duwen ohl menet, e kak kihong kitail uduke pwe kitail en kang?”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: ma kumwail sohte pahn tungoale uduk en Nein-Aramas, oh nim ntah, nahn, mour soutuk sohte pahn mi loalamwail.
Mehmen me kin tungoale udukei oh nim ntahi, iei ih me ahneki mour soutuk, oh I pahn komourada ni imwilahn rahn.
Pwe udukei oh ntahi iei sak mehlel.
Mehmen me kin tungoale udukei oh nim ntahi, e kin ehuong ie, oh I kin ehuong.
Duwen Sahm ieias eh ketin kadariehdo, oh I kin momour pwehki ih, ih duwen mehmen me kin tungoale udukei pahn momour pwehki ngehi.
Eri, ih met pilawa me kohdihdo sang nanleng; kaidehn soahngo me samamwail kahlap ako tungoaleier, a mwuhr re mehla. Mehmen me kin tungoale pilawa wet pahn momour kohkohlahte.”
Sises ketin mahsanih mepwukat nan sinakokeo, ni eh ketin padapadahkseli nan Kapernaum.
Mahsen en Mour Soutuk
Eri, me tohto sang nanpwungen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko lao rongada mepwukat, re ahpw nda, “Padahk pwoatet meid nohn apwal! Ihs me kak rong?”
Sohte me patohwanohng Sises, a pein ih ketin mwahngih me sapwellime tohnpadahk ko lipahnedkihla duwen mepwukat. E ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ia duwe, padahk pwoatet pil kahredahr amwail peikasal?
Ia duwen ma kumwail kilang Nein-Aramas eh pahn ketin pwuradalahng wasa me e ketin kousoanehr ie mahs?
Ngenen Koht me kin kihong mour, a manaman en aramas, iei mehkot mwahl. Mahsen kan me I kin padahkihong kumwail, iei Ngehn oh mour.
A ekei kumwail sohte pwoson.” (Pwe Sises ketin mwahngih sang nin tapio ihs rehrail me sohte kin pwoson, oh pil ihs ohlo me pahn pangala.)
Oh e pil ketin mahsanih, “Iei kahrepe wet me I ndahkihongkumwailehr me sohte emen kak kohdo rehi, ma Sahmo sohte ketin mweidohng.”
Pwehki padahk wet, me tohto sang nanpwungen irail kan me ideidawehn Sises mweikihsangehr oh solahr men idawehn.
Sises eri mahsanihong me ehk riemeno, “Ia duwe, kumwail pil men keseiehla?”
Saimon Piter ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, ihs me se pahn patohla reh? Sapwellimomwi mahsen kan, iei mahsen en mour soutuk.
Eri, met se pwosonlahr oh eseier me Sapwellimen Koht me Sarawio komwi.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ngehi, I piladahr kumwail me ehk riemen. Eri soh, emen nanpwungamwail me tepil!”
E ketin mahsanihki met pwehki Sudas, nein Saimon Iskariot; pwe mehnda ma e kisehn ehk riemeno, ahpw e pahn pangala Sises.
